item.text: The current loader reads through global Viper state and only copies a subset of keys; startup also hardcodes the HTTP port and plaintext listeners. I’m replacing that with a path based loader that overlays defaults, handles scalar or list CORS origins, validates certificates, and applies the selected scheme to both REST/UI and gRPC.
